summary: Empery Digital Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that between May 7 and July 10, 2026, it sold 1,400 BTC at an average price of $62,200 for gross proceeds of ~$87.1M, using the cash to repay $10M of debt, fund a previously announced property acquisition, and pay legal expenses. As of July 10, 2026, the company held 1,514 BTC, ~$73.9M cash, and $45M outstanding debt. This is an ordinary operational update—not a special situation event—so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
